I am a widow-aged woman here in Dowa, farming my small piece of land. On this bean plot I do not usually put chemical fertilizer — the FISP coupon, when I get it, I save for my maize plot because maize is what feeds the family. Beans fix their own nitrogen, so I just spread some manure from my goats before planting, and I use the seed I saved from last season because improved bean seed is expensive and hard to find here. I weed with my hoe myself, maybe with help from my daughter, and I do not hire people or irrigate — we wait for the rains like always.
